A '''cult''' existed within the [[Baran Do]], a [[The Force/Legends|Force-using]] group of sages of the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The cult sought to join the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]],<ref name="Corruption of the Baran Do" /> an order of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-siders]],<ref name="Sith Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Sith Pureblood}}</ref> and worshipped the [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sion]].<ref name="Corruption of the Baran Do" /> Long before [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Crime Doesn't Pay" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the cult supposedly became defunct, however it continued to operate in secret.<ref name="Corruption of the Baran Do" /> By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the cult operated in an ancient [[Baran Do monastery]], where the cultists left offerings to Darth Sion. Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] uncovered evidence of a conspiracy to conceal the existence of the supposedly defunct cult.<ref name="Corruption of the Baran Do" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The individual subsequently sent a companion of theirs to seek information on the cult. The companion discovered the monastery and retrieved the offerings the cultists had left for Darth Sion.<ref name="Corruption of the Baran Do" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The cult was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Corruption of the Baran Do" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Corruption of the Baran Do" />
